description: This file defines the 'Cart' class, representing a user's shopping cart within an e-commerce application's backend. It includes properties like cart ID, associated user, list of items, and last update timestamp, along with methods to manipulate the cart items and handle persistence details.

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: Entity class representing a shopping cart tied to a user, managing cart items and tracking last update time.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds a CartItem to the cart, setting its cart reference and updating the timestamp.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes a CartItem from the cart, nullifying its cart reference and updating the timestamp.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the cart.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the User associated with this cart.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Sets the User associated with this cart.

methods.name: getItems
methods.description: Returns the list of items in the cart.

methods.name: setItems
methods.description: Replaces the current list of cart items with a new list, adding each item appropriately.

methods.name: getUpdatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the last update to the cart.

methods.name: setUpdatedAt
methods.description: Sets the last updated timestamp of the cart.
